title: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
english: A recent BBC report provides a rare look at how the Taliban governs Afghanistan, highlighting the severe restrictions placed on women. In one incident, a governor dismissed an 18-year-old woman's request for divorce from her abusive husband by labeling women as inferior. Five years after taking power, the Taliban continues to enforce strict religious laws that exclude women from public life, education, and employment.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ዘገባ ታሊባን አፍጋኒስታንን እንዴት እንደሚያስተዳድርና በሴቶች ላይ የሚጥሉትን ከባድ ገደቦች በግልጽ ያሳያል። አንድ የክልል አስተዳዳሪ ከአስር ስምንት ዓመት ወጣት ሴት የቀረበላትን የፍቺ ጥያቄ ውድቅ በማድረግ ሴቶች የማሰብ ችሎታቸው ዝቅተኛ ነው የሚል አድሎአዊ አስተያየት ሰጥቷል። ሥልጣን ከያዙ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላም፣ ቡድኑ ሴቶችን ከትምህርት፣ ከሥራና ከማኅበራዊ ሕይወት የሚያገሉ ጥብቅ ሕጎችን መተግበሩን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Gabaasni BBC dhiheenya kana bahe, gareen Taliban afgaanistaan akkamitti akka bulchuufi mirga dubartootarratti dhorkaa cimaa akka kaa'e agarsiisa. Haala kanaan, hogganaan naannichaa tokko dubartii umriinshee waggaa 18 ta'e kan abbaa manaa ishee irraa gargar ba'uu barbaaddeef, dubartoota salphisuun deebii kenneera. Taliban waggaa shaniif aangootti erga turee boodas, dubartoonni barnoota, hojiifi jireenya hawaasummaa irraa akka bahaniif seera cimaa amantii irratti hundaa'e hojiirra oolchuu itti fufeera.

title: Former CIA officer describes Aipac's rise to political power
english: In a recent discussion, former CIA officer John Kiriakou and journalist Tucker Carlson examined the political influence of AIPAC and Israel in Washington. They revisited controversial historical events, including the 1967 attack on the USS Liberty and alleged Israeli involvement in the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. Kiriakou claimed that the U.S. government suppressed evidence regarding these incidents to protect its relationship with Israel.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሲአይኤ ኦፊሰር ጆን ኪሪያኩ እና ጋዜጠኛ ታከር ካርልሰን በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ የ AIPAC እና የእስራኤልን በዋሽንግተን ላይ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ መርምረዋል። በውይይታቸውም እ.ኤ.አ በ1967 በዩኤስኤስ ሊበርቲ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት እና የፕሬዚዳንት ጆን ኤፍ ኬኔዲ ግድያ ውስጥ እስራኤል እጇ አለበት የሚሉ አወዛጋቢ ታሪካዊ ክስተቶችን አንስተዋል። ኪሪያኩ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከእስራኤል ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማስቀጠል ሲባል ስለነዚህ ክስተቶች የተባለውን ማስረጃ እንዳፈነው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan duraanii CIA John Kiriakou fi gaazexeessaan Tucker Carlson marii taasisaniin, dhiibbaa siyaasaa AIPAC fi Israa'el Waashingitan keessatti qaban irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Marii isaanii keessatti, haleellaa doonii USS Liberty irratti bara 1967 raawwatamee fi gahee Israa'el ajjeechaa pirezidaant John F. Kennedy keessatti qabaachuu dandeessu kan ibsan seenaa wal-falchiisoo ta'an kaaseeru. Kiriakou akka jedhetti, mootummaan Ameerikaa hariiroo Israa'el wajjin qabu eeggachuuf jecha odeeffannoo fi ragaalee taatee kanaa dhoksuuf yaaleera.

title: Israeli military advances into a village in Syria's Daraa
english: Israeli military forces have entered the village of Maariya, located in the Daraa region of southern Syria. Reports indicate that the troops were accompanied by various military vehicles during this movement. This development marks a notable escalation in the border area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ ዳራ በሚገኘው የማሪያ መንደር መግባታቸው ተዘግቧል። ወታደሮቹ ወደ ስፍራው የገቡት በተለያዩ ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች የታጀቡ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢ ያለው ውጥረት መጨመሩን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Maariyaa kan naannoo Daaraa kibba Sooriyaatti argamtu seenuu isaanii gabaafameera. Waraanni kun konkolaataalee waraanaatiin deeggaramee gara ganda kanaatti akka socho'e ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun naannoo daangaa sanaatti waraanni kun babal'achuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
english: A group of 21 former international cricket captains has sent a formal request to Pakistan's Prime Minister, urging him to provide adequate medical attention to imprisoned former leader Imran Khan. The group emphasizes that Khan, who is 73, should be allowed access to his own doctors and receive consistent care for his health issues, including a reported loss of vision. They are calling for the government to follow court orders by granting him proper medical evaluations and regular family visits without any unnecessary delays.
amharic: 21 የቀድሞ ዓለም አቀፍ የክሪኬት ቡድን መሪዎች ለፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በጻፉት ደብዳቤ፣ በእስር ላይ ለሚገኙት የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ተገቢው የህክምና አገልግሎት እንዲሰጥ ጠይቀዋል። የቡድኑ አባላት የ73 ዓመቱ ኢምራን ካን የራሳቸው የግል ዶክተሮች እንዲያዩዋቸው እና በተለይም በዓይናቸው ላይ የደረሰውን ችግር ጨምሮ አስፈላጊው ህክምና በአስቸኳይ እንዲደረግላቸው አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም መንግስት የፍርድ ቤቱን ትዕዛዝ በማክበር ምንም አይነት መዘግየት ሳይኖር የቤተሰብ ጉብኝት እንዲፈቀድላቸው ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: gareen kapteinota kirikeetii 21 ta'an kan duraanii, waldaan gara muummee ministira Paakistaan barreessaniin, duraan geggeessituu biyyattii kan ta'an Imran Kaan mana hidhaa keessatti yaala fayyaa gahaa akka argatan gaafataniiru. Gareen kun akka jedhutti, Imran Kaan umuriin isaanii 73 ta'uu isaa fi dhibee ijji isaanii irratti mul'ate dabalatee yaala fayyaa barbaachisu akka argatan, akkasumas ogeeyyota fayyaa isaanii mataa isaanii bira gahuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, mootummaan ajaja mana murtiitiin maatiin isaanii yeroo hundaa akka isaan daawwatan akkasumas yaalli isaan barbaachisu osoo hin harkifatin akka kennamuuf gaafataniiru.

title: Maradona’s ‘Hand of God’ ball from Mexico sells for $3.35m
english: The soccer ball used during the famous 1986 World Cup match between Argentina and England was auctioned for $3.35 million. This ball was involved in two iconic moments: Diego Maradona’s controversial 'Hand of God' goal and his incredible 'Goal of the Century.' Argentina won that historic game, eventually leading them to become the tournament champions.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ1986 በአርጀንቲና እና በእንግሊዝ መካከል በተደረገው ዝነኛ የዓለም ዋንጫ ጨዋታ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው የእግር ኳስ ኳስ በ3.35 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ተሽጧል። ይህ ኳስ ዲያጎ ማራዶና በኳስ በታገዘ ጎል ባስቆጠረበት 'የእግዚአብሔር እጅ' እና በታሪክ ተወዳዳሪ በሌለው 'የክፍለ ዘመኑ ጎል' ወቅት አገልግሎት ላይ ውሏል። አርጀንቲና በዚያ ታሪካዊ ጨዋታ በማሸነፍ በመጨረሻ የዓለም ዋንጫውን ማንሳት ችላለች።
oromo: Kubaan miillaa kan bara 1986 tapha seena-qabeessa waancaa addunyaa kan Arjantiinii fi Ingiliz gidduutti taphatame irratti itti fayyadaman, qarshii miliyoona 3.35n gurgurameera. Kubaan kun yeroo Diyaagoo Maaradoonaan goolii 'Harka Waaqayyoo' jedhamuun beekamu fi 'Goolii Jaarraa' jedhamee waamamu seenaa hojjetetti itti fayyadame dha. Arjantiiniin tapha seena-qabeessa sana injifattee, boodarras waancaa addunyaa sana mo'achuun ishee ni yaadatama.

title: Climbers escape rockfall crossing ‘Death Pass’ on Mont Blanc
english: A group of mountain climbers narrowly survived a dangerous rockfall while navigating the Goûter Couloir, a section of Mont Blanc notoriously called Death Pass. A climber captured the terrifying event on video while he and his partner worked to help other hikers reach safety. Fortunately, everyone involved managed to avoid the falling debris and escape the area unharmed.
amharic: በሞንት ብላንክ ተራራ ላይ የሚገኘውን እና ‘የሞት ማለፊያ’ ተብሎ በሚጠራው ስፍራ ላይ የሚጓዙ ተራራ ወጣቾች ከባድ የድንጋይ መפולቀቅ አጋጥሟቸው በታምር ተረፉ። አንድ ወጣች በቪዲዮ የቀረጸው ይህ ክስተት፣ እሱ እና አጋሩ ሌሎች ተጓዦች ከአደጋው እንዲያመልጡ ሲረዱ የሚያሳይ ነው። እንደ እድል ሆኖ፣ ሁሉም ተሳታፊዎች ከድንጋዮቹ ፍርስራሽ በመትረፍ ደህና መሆናቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Gaara Mont Blanc irratti bakka 'Godaansa Du'aa' jedhamuun beekamu keessa kan turan namoonni gaara bahatan tokko, dhagaan suuta gadi dhangala'uun lubbuun isaanii daangaa irra ga'ee ture. Namni tokko viidiyoodhaan waraabe akka agarsiisutti, inni fi hiriyoonni isaa namoota biroo rakkoo kana keessaa baasuuf gargaarsa godhaniiru. Gamtaan, namoonni hundinuu dhagaa gadi bu'aa ture sana jalaa lubbuun hafan.

title: ‘We know this movie’: Iran mocks latest US sanctions
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has dismissed the latest round of US sanctions as a repetitive and ineffective strategy. He compared the move to watching an old film, suggesting that current American pressure tactics are essentially the same as those used by previous administrations. Araghchi characterized these measures as bullying that fails to change the existing political reality.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ አዲሱን የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ እንደ ተደጋጋሚ እና ውጤት አልባ ድርጊት አጣጥለውታል። ሚኒስትሩ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምትጥለው ማዕቀብ ቀደም ሲል ከነበሩት የአሜሪካ አስተዳደሮች የተለየ አይደለም ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ይህንን ድርጊትም የጉልበት ብልጠት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ምንም አይነት ለውጥ እንደማያመጣ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchii, adabbiiwwan haaraa Ameerikaan irra keette kana akka gocha baramaa fi bu'aa hin qabneetti fudhataniiru. Gocha kana filmii yeroo hedduu mul'atu waliin kan wal-mamsiisan yoo ta'u, dhiibbaan Ameerikaa kun kan bulchiinsa kanaan duraa irraa adda akka hin taane dubbataniiru. Araagchiin adeemsa kana gocha qabeenyi itti mul'atu fi jijjiirama tokkollee fiduu hin dandeenye jedhanii ibsaniiru.

title: Syria, Israel hold US-mediated talks in Jordan to de-escalate tensions
english: Syrian and Israeli officials recently held high-level meetings in Jordan, facilitated by the United States, to reduce rising military tensions. The discussions, which included the head of the Mossad and the Syrian Foreign Minister, aimed to establish security protocols and end ongoing border strikes. Furthermore, the parties addressed the need to prevent the rivalry between Israel and Turkey from destabilizing the Syrian region.
amharic: የሶሪያ እና የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በዮርዳኖስ ተገናኝተው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ ተወያይተዋል። በውይይቱ ላይ የሞሳድ መሪ እና የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር የተሳተፉ ሲሆን፣ ዓላማውም በድንበር አካባቢ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶችን ለማስቆም እና የፀጥታ ስምምነት ለመፍጠር ነው። በተጨማሪም ሁለቱ ወገኖች በእስራኤል እና በቱርክ መካከል ያለው አለመግባባት በሶሪያ ላይ ተጨማሪ ችግር እንዳይፈጥር ለመከላከል ተነጋግረዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Siriyaa fi Israa'eel waldhabdee gidduu isaanii jiru hir'isuuf, fedhii Ameerikaatiin biyya Yoordaanos keessatti wal arganii mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun mataa dhaabbata basaasaa Israa'eel (Mossad) fi ministira dhimmi alaa Siiriyaa kan hirmaachise yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas haleellaa daangaa irratti gaggeeffamu dhaabuufi nageenya mirkaneessuu dha. Kana malees, gamtaan lameen kun waldhabdeen Israa'eelii fi Turkiyee gidduu jiru biyya Siiriyaa keessatti miidhaa akka hin geessisne mari'ataniiru.

title: Burnham to visit Kyiv on first foreign trip and reaffirm UK support for Ukraine
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will travel to Kyiv for his first official international visit to mark Ukraine’s independence day and demonstrate the UK's ongoing commitment to the country. During his trip, he will lead a meeting of the 'coalition of the willing' and accept an award acknowledging Britain's assistance. This visit serves to confirm Britain’s resolve in supporting Ukraine against Russian aggression despite recent threats from Moscow.
amharic: የብሪታንያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የዩክሬንን የነጻነት ቀን ለማክበር እና ለሀገሪቱ ያላቸውን ቀጣይ ድጋፍ ለማረጋገጥ የመጀመሪያ የውጭ ጉብኝታቸውን ወደ ኪየቭ ያደርጋሉ። በጉብኝታቸውም የ'ፈቃደኞች ጥምረት' ስብሰባን የሚመሩ ሲሆን ለዩክሬን የብሪታንያን ድጋፍ የሚያሳይ ሽልማት ይቀበላሉ። ይህ ጉብኝት ከሩሲያ የሚሰነዘሩ ማስፈራሪያዎች ቢኖሩም ብሪታንያ በዩክሬን ላይ ለምትሰጠው ድጋፍ ያላትን ጽናት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Biriiteen Antii Barnhaam guyyaa bilisummaa Yukreen kabajuufi deeggarsa biyyattiin Yukreeniif qabdu mirkaneessuuf imala alaa isaanii isa jalqabaa gara Kiyevitti taasisaniiru. Imala isaaniin, walgahii 'gamtaa fedhii qaban' jedhamu kan hoogganan ta'uufi badhaasa deeggarsa Biriiteen Yukreeniif goote agarsiisu fudhatu. Imalli kun sodaachisa Raashiyaa irraa dhufu cinaatti, Biriiteen yukreen gargaaruurratti qabdu cimsattee akka itti fuftu kan mirkaneessudha.

title: Shein aims for almost $27bn valuation in stock market debut
english: The fast-fashion company Shein is set to launch an initial public offering on the Hong Kong stock exchange, aiming for a valuation of nearly $27 billion. This target is significantly lower than its previous $100 billion valuation from 2022 due to rising costs and declining sales. The company has faced recent financial challenges, including quarterly losses, which were partly triggered by new US import taxes and increased operational expenses.
amharic: ፈጣን የፋሽን ኩባንያ የሆነው ሺኢን በሆንግ ኮንግ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ላይ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አክሲዮኖቹን በመሸጥ ወደ 27 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ የገበያ ዋጋ ለመድረስ አቅዷል። ይህ የታቀደው ዋጋ በ2022 ከነበረው 100 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ጋር ሲነጻጸር በጣም ዝቅተኛ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ኩባንያው የገጠመውን ከፍተኛ ወጪ እና የሽያጭ መቀነስ ያሳያል። ኩባንያው በአሜሪካ የታሪፍ ለውጦች እና ሌሎች ተያያዥ ችግሮች ምክንያት በቅርቡ የሩብ ዓመት ኪሳራ አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni uffata qulqulluu fi saffisaa oomishu Shein, gabaa akkooyyee Hong Kong irratti qooda isaa gurgurachuudhaan gatii tilmaama biiliyoona 27 ga'u argachuuf karoorfateera. Gatiin kun bara 2022 keessa turee fi biiliyoona 100 wajjin yoo madaalamu baay'ee kan gadi bu'e yoo ta'u, kunis baasii dabale fi gabaa irratti hir'ina mudateen kan walqabatedha. Dhaabbatichi gibira alaa ergii Amerikaa fi rakkoolee biroo mudataniin walqabatee, ji'oota darban keessa kasaaraa mudachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Nearly 3 million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
english: China has issued a massive recall for nearly three million Tesla vehicles and millions of other EVs due to safety concerns regarding retractable door handles. Authorities worry these hidden designs make it difficult to open doors during emergencies or power failures, posing a risk to passengers and rescuers. In response, Tesla will provide software updates and safety labels, while China prepares to mandate mechanical door releases for all new vehicles by 2027.
amharic: ቻይና በኤሌክትሪክ ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ የሚገኙ የበር መክፈቻዎች ደህንነት ስጋት በመፍጠራቸው ወደ ሶስት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ የቴስላ መኪኖችን ጨምሮ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሌሎች ተሽከርካሪዎችን አስታውሳለች። እነዚህ በሰውነት ውስጥ ተሰውረው የሚቀመጡ የበር መያዣዎች፣ በድንገተኛ አደጋ ጊዜ ለመክፈት አስቸጋሪ በመሆናቸው ለተሳፋሪዎችና ለነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አደጋ ሊያስከትሉ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል። ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ቴስላ የሶፍትዌር ማሻሻያዎችን እና የማስጠንቀቂያ ምልክቶችን የሚያቀርብ ሲሆን፣ የቻይና መንግስትም ከ2027 ጀምሮ ሁሉም አዳዲስ መኪኖች በእጅ የሚከፈት ሜካኒካዊ ዘዴ እንዲኖራቸው አዟል።
oromo: Chaayinaan konkolaattota Tesla miiliyoona sadii dhiyoo ta'an dabalatee, konkolaattota elektirikii biroo miiliyoonatti lakkaa'aman rakkoo nageenyaa harka-duubee balbala (door handles) irraa kan ka'e akka deebifaman ajajdeetti. Harka-duubee balbala kanneen balaa tasaa ykn yeroo humna elektirikaa dhabamu irraan kan ka'e banuun ulfaataa waan ta'eef, lubbuu namootaatiif sodaachisaa ta'uu isaa mootummaan ibseera. Tesla rakkoo kana furuuf fooyya'insa sooftiweerii fi mallattoo akeekkachiisaa kan kennu yoo ta'u, Chaayinaanis bara 2027 irraa eegalee konkolaattoonni hundi sirna balbala bifa mekaanikaatiin banamu qabaachuu akka qaban labsitetti.

title: Human-caused Nevada wildfire forces 42,000 people to evacuate
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire sparked by human activity near Reno, Nevada, has triggered the evacuation of 42,000 residents, with tens of thousands more remaining on standby. The blaze has caused six injuries and damaged multiple houses in the area. Authorities are currently investigating the exact circumstances surrounding how the fire started.
amharic: በኔቫዳ፣ ሬኖ አቅራቢያ በሰው ሰራሽ ድርጊት የተነሳው ፈጣን የእሳት ቃጠሎ 42,000 ነዋሪዎችን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አስገድዷል፣ ሌሎች በርካታ ሺህ ሰዎችም ዝግጁ እንዲሆኑ ተነግሯቸዋል። እሳቱ ስድስት ሰዎችን አቁስሏል እንዲሁም በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን አውድሟል። ባለስልጣናት የእሳቱን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Reno, Nevada tti ibiddi namtolchee hatattamaan ka'e jiraattota 42,000 ta'an qe'ee isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqisiiseera, namoonni kumni 45 ol ta'anis eeggannoo cimaa keessa jiru. Iddoo kanaatti ibiddi kun namoota ja'a irratti miidhaa geessisee manneen jireenyaas barbadeesseera. Abbootiin taayitaa sababa ibidda kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Can Kenya’s AI ambitions coexist with Naivasha’s water needs?
english: Kenya is planning to host a massive data center near Lake Naivasha backed by Microsoft and G42 to advance its artificial intelligence goals. However, local residents are concerned that this project might worsen existing water shortages that already threaten their livestock and daily survival. While developers promise to use renewable energy and water-saving technology, the community remains anxious about the potential strain on their vital water resources.
amharic: ኬንያ በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፍ ያላትን ዓላማ ለማሳካት በማይክሮሶፍት እና በጂ-42 ድጋፍ ናይቫሻ ሀይቅ አቅራቢያ ትልቅ የዳታ ማዕከል ለመገንባት እቅድ አውጥታለች። ይሁን እንጂ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ይህ ፕሮጀክት ለቤት እንስሳቶቻቸው እና ለዕለት ተዕለት ኑሯቸው የሚያስፈልገውን ውኃ እጥረት ይበልጥ ያባብሰዋል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የፕሮጀክቱ ባለቤቶች ታዳሽ ኃይል እና ውኃ ቆጣቢ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን እንደሚጠቀሙ ቢገልጹም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ በውኃ ሀብታቸው ላይ ሊደርስ ስለሚችለው ተፅዕኖ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Keenyaan karoora fayyadama teeknooloojii aritifishal intelejensii (AI) cimsuuf, dhaabbilee Maaykiroosoftii fi G-42 waliin ta'uun buufata daataa gurguddaa Naayvaashaatti ijaaruuf qophoofteetti. Haa ta'u malee, jiraattonni naannichaa, proojektiin kun hanqina bishaanii isaanii duraan iyyuu qunname akka hammaatuufi beeyiladoota isaanii irratti dhiibbaa akka geessisu sodaatu. Dhaabbileen kunniin humna haaromsuufi teeknooloojii bishaan qusatu akka fayyadaman waadaa seenanis, hawaasni naannichaa ga'umsa qabeenya bishaanii isaanii irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabu.

title: Ebola cases in DRC hit 5,515 as Pope Leo urges global action to save lives
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,515 cases with a high fatality rate of nearly 48 percent. Pope Leo has appealed for urgent international assistance to combat the crisis, which is further complicated by regional conflict and infrastructure challenges. Although vaccination efforts are underway, global health officials emphasize that the response must be significantly increased to stop the spread of the virus.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ቁጥር 5,515 ደርሷል፤ ይህም የሞት ምጣኔው ወደ 48 በመቶ እንዲያድግ አድርጓል። ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ በግጭትና በችግር የታጀበውን ይህን ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የክትባት ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ ቢሆንም፣ ቫይረሱን ለመግታት ዓለም አቀፍ የጤና ተቋማት ምላሹ አሁን ካለው በሁለት እና በሶስት እጥፍ ሊጨምር እንደሚገባ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa Rippabliika Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti babal’ateen namootni 5,515 qabamuun isaanii fi namootni 2,642 du’uun isaanii ibsameera. Paappaas Liiyoon rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa akka barbaachisu kan gaafatan yoo ta’u, dhibichis walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa fi hanqina bu’uuraalee misoomaatiin hammeenyaan itti fufee jira. Hanga ammaatti talaalliiwwan gahaa ta’an qaqqabanis, dhaabbileen fayyaa idil-addunyaa tattaaffiin hanga amma taasifamaa jiru gahaa waan hin taaneef, deebiin kennamu dachaa lama ykn sadiin dabaluu akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: India crushes cockroach dissent as ‘Fix Schools’ campaign riles Modi
english: The Cockroach Janta Party is facing significant resistance from the Indian government and BJP supporters for its initiative to monitor and improve state-run schools. Volunteers conducting these inspections have been targeted by attacks and legal intervention by authorities who claim the school visits are unauthorized. This confrontation highlights growing tensions over public school conditions and the government's response to civilian oversight.
amharic: የኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ በመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች ላይ ክትትል በማድረግ ለውጥ ለማምጣት የሚያደርገው ጥረት በመንግስት እና በገዢው ፓርቲ ደጋፊዎች ዘንድ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ትምህርት ቤቶችን የሚጎበኙ በጎ ፈቃደኞች ጥቃት እየደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ጉብኝቶቹ ህገወጥ ናቸው በሚል ህጋዊ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰዱ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ሁኔታ የመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች አቅም እና በዜጎች ቁጥጥር ላይ ያለው የመንግስት አቋም ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ ውስጥ መግባቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin 'Cockroach Janta' jedhamu manneen barnoota mootummaa fooyyessuuf yaalii inni godhu hoggantoota mootummaa fi deggertoota paartii biyya bulchu biratti mormiin guddaan irra ga'aa jira. Hayyoonni fedhii isaaniitiin manneen barnootaa kana sakatta'an miidhaa fi tarkaanfiin poolisii akka irratti fudhatamu taasifamaa jira; mootummaan immoo daawwannaan kun seeraan alaa dha jedha. Wali-dhabdeen kun haala manneen barnoota mootummaa fi akkaataa mootummaan hordoffii ummataa itti ilaalutti rakkoo jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Iranian cyber attack shuts down UK power plant for four days, report says
english: A small British power plant was forced to close for four days following a cyber attack attributed to Iranian hackers. While officials confirmed the incident, they stated that the broader national energy grid remained secure and unaffected. This event coincides with similar digital attacks targeting water infrastructure across the United States.
amharic: ኢራንን ከሚደግፉ ጠላፊዎች (ሀከሮች) በተሰነዘረ የሳይበር ጥቃት ምክንያት በብሪታንያ የሚገኝ አንድ አነስተኛ የኃይል ማመንጫ ለስድስት ቀናት ያህል ተዘግቶ ነበር። የብሪታንያ ባለሥልጣናት ጉዳዩን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን ጥቃቱ በአገሪቱ አጠቃላይ የኃይል አቅርቦት ላይ ምንም ዓይነት ስጋት እንዳልፈጠረ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በአሜሪካ የውሃ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከደረሱ ተመሳሳይ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች ጋር ተያይዞ ተከስቷል።
oromo: Hackeronni Iran waliin hidhata qaban, buufata humna ibsaa xiqqaa tokko irratti miidhaa geessisuun guyyoota afuriif akka cufamu godhaniiru. Mootummaan Biritish akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun buufata sanatti malee guddina humna ibsaa biyyattii irratti balaa hin geessisne. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo buufataalee bishaanii Ameerikaa irratti haleellaan wal-fakkaataan geggeeffamaa turetti dha.

title: Less than 20 ships transit Strait of Hormuz over weekend
english: Data indicates that fewer than 20 ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend. While 17 vessels were officially recorded, the exact number is likely higher because some ships turned off their tracking devices. This vital maritime route remains a point of observation due to these navigational inconsistencies.
amharic: በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ከ20 በታች የሚሆኑ መርከቦች የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ማለፋቸውን መረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። በይፋ የተመዘገቡት 17 መርከቦች ቢሆኑም፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች መከታተያ መሳሪያዎቻቸውን በማጥፋታቸው ትክክለኛው ቁጥር ከዚህ በላይ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገልጿል። ይህ ወሳኝ የባህር መስመር በመርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ በሚታዩ እርግጠኛ ባልሆኑ ሁኔታዎች ምክንያት በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon akka agarsiisutti, dhuma torban darbe kana markaboonni 20 gadi ta'an qofa harka galaana Hormuz darbeera. Lakkoofsi seera qabeessa ta'e markaboota 17 ta'us, markaboonni tokko tokko meeshaa ittiin of hordofan waan cufataniif lakkoofsi sirrii ta'e sanaa ol ta'uu danda'a. Daandiin galaanaa barbaachisaan kun sochiin markabootaa ifa waan hin taaneef xiyyeeffannoo keessa jira.

title: Large forest fire burns close to residential areas in Ankara
english: A significant forest fire has broken out near the Mamak district on the edge of Ankara, Turkey. The blaze is currently posing a direct threat to nearby residential properties. Emergency crews are working to manage the situation as the fire spreads close to human settlements.
amharic: በቱርክ ዋና ከተማ አንካራ ዳርቻ በሚገኘው ማማክ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የደን ቃጠሎ ተቀስቅሷል። እሳቱ በአካባቢው ወደሚገኙ የመኖሪያ ቤቶች በመጠጋቱ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች እሳቱ ወደ መኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እንዳይዛመት ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa guddittii Turkiyii Ankaraa keessatti, naannoo Maamaakitti ibiddee bosonaa cimaan ka'ee jira. Ibidni kun maneen jireenyaa naannichatti argaman irratti balaa agarsiisaa jira. Hojjettoonni humna ittisa balaa ibidicha gara maneen jireenyaatti akka hin babal'anne to'achuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Tokayev allies head for landslide victory in Kazakhstan elections
english: President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s political allies are poised for a massive victory in Kazakhstan's latest parliamentary elections, with exit polls showing his party securing roughly 70 percent of the vote. This overwhelming success further strengthens the President's control over the nation. The outcome reinforces Tokayev's authority in the resource-rich country, which maintains strategic partnerships with China and Russia.
amharic: በካዛክስታን በተካሄደው የፓርላማ ምርጫ የፕሬዚዳንት ካሲም-ጆማርት ቶካየቭ አጋር የሆኑት ፓርቲዎች ሰፊ ድል እየተቀዳጁ መሆኑን ከምርጫ ጣቢያዎች የተገኙ መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። የፕሬዚዳንቱ ፓርቲ ወደ 70 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ድምፅ በማግኘት በሀገሪቱ ላይ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ የበለጠ አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ውጤት ሩሲያ እና ቻይና ጋር ጠንካራ ግንኙነት ባላት በዚህ ሀብታም ሀገር የፕሬዚዳንት ቶካየቭን ስልጣን ከፍ ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Filannoo paarlaamaa Kaazaakhistaanirratti deeggartonni pirezidaant Kaassim-Joomart Tookaayeew injifannoo guddaa gonfachuuf deemaa jiru. Akka odeeffannoo irraa hubatamutti, paartiin pirezidaantichaa sagalee harka 70 ol argachuun isaanii aangoo isaanii caalaatti cimsuuf gargaara. Bu'aan kun biyya qabeenya uumamaatiin badhaadheefi hariiroo cimaa Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa waliin qabdu kana keessatti aangoo pirezidaantichaa daran jabeessa.

title: Israeli drone strike kills two in central Gaza
english: Two Palestinian men were killed early Monday following an Israeli drone attack on a camp for displaced people in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza. Additional airstrikes and artillery fire were reported near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital and the Maghazi refugee camp. These ongoing military operations occur amid a conflict that has caused tens of thousands of casualties since late 2023.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በዴይር አል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ከአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል አቅራቢያ እና ማጋዚ የስደተኞች ካምፕ አቅጣጫዎች ተጨማሪ የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶች ተከስተዋል። እነዚህ ቀጣይነት ያላቸው ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እ.ኤ.አ. ከ2023 መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እና ቀውስ ያስከተለውን ጦርነት አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Dilbata gara Wiixataatti ce'uun, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) Israa'el ganda Deir al-Balah, giddu-galeessa Gaazaatti raawwattee namoota lamatu ajjeeffame. Haleellaan xiyyaara waraanaa fi meeshaa gurguddaa biraas hospitaala Al-Aqsaa fi ganda baqattootaa Magaazii biratti gabaafameera. Haleellaan kun hundi, waraana bara 2023 irraa eegalee lubbuu namoota kumaatamaa galaafate keessatti kan itti fufe dha.

title: Israeli forces storm Syria’s Quneitra, detain a civilian
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid into the Quneitra province located in southern Syria this past Sunday. During this operation, soldiers captured and detained a local civilian who was working as a shepherd. This incident marks another instance of cross-border activity between the two nations.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ባለፈው እሁድ በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ በምትገኘው ኩኔትራ ግዛት ዘመቻ አካሂደዋል። በዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ወቅት በግጦሽ ላይ የነበረ አንድ የአካባቢው ነዋሪ በወታደሮቹ ተይዞ ተወስዷል። ይህም በሁለቱ ሀገራት ድንበር አካባቢ የተከሰተ ሌላው የውጥረት ክስተት ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el dilbata darbe naannoo Quneitra kan kibba Siriyaatti argamu weeraruun duula gaggeessaniiru. Duula kanaanis, tiksee loonii kan ta'e namni lammilee tokko waraanaan qabamee fudhatameera. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa daangaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumame keessaa isa tokko.

title: Yemeni army claims attacks on Houthis
english: The Yemeni military has reported carrying out drone strikes against various Houthi locations, including troop barracks and gathering areas. Although the army released video evidence of the operation, they have not disclosed the specific locations involved. Additionally, there has been no official information provided regarding the number of casualties resulting from these attacks.
amharic: የየመን ጦር በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የመሰብሰቢያ ቦታዎች እና የጦር ሰፈሮች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። የጦር ሰራዊቱ ጥቃቱን የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ ቢያደርግም፣ ቦታው የት እንደሆነ ወይም ስለደረሰው ጉዳትና የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጠም።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Yaman bakkeewwan humni Huutii itti argaman, kanneen akka buufata waraanaa fi iddoo walga’ii irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeessuu isaa beeksisera. Waraanichi viidiyoo haleellichaa gadi lakkiseera ta’us, iddoo haleellaan sun itti raawwatame ykn waa’ee miidhaa namaa fi qabeenyaa ga’ee tokkollee hin ibsine.

title: Iran war live: Iranian parliament advances plans for Hormuz service fees
english: The Iranian parliament is moving forward with a new proposal that would require international ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz to pay service fees to Tehran. This development comes amid rising tensions, as the U.S. government expresses its intention to cut off Iran’s economic resources. The proposed legislation aims to establish a formal system for charging vessels that navigate these critical waters.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የሚያልፉ አለም አቀፍ መርከቦች ለቴህራን የአገልግሎት ክፍያ እንዲከፍሉ የሚያስገድድ ረቂቅ ህግ በማዘጋጀት ላይ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው አሜሪካ የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚያዊ አቅም ለማዳከም እየጣረች ባለችበት ወቅት ነው። የቀረበው ረቂቅ ህግ በነዚህ ወሳኝ የውሃ መስመሮች በሚጓዙ መርከቦች ላይ ክፍያ የመጣል ስርዓትን ለመዘርጋት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree biyyattii Iraan, markaboonni daandii bishaan Hormuz keessa darban tajaajilaaf kaffaltii akka kaffalan seera haaraa qopheessaa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufeyyuu mootummaan Ameerikaa diinagdee Iraan laaffisuuf karoora qabatee jiru keessatti. Seerri kun daandiiwwan bishaan idil-addunyaa kana keessa qaxxaamuraniif sirna kaffaltii diriirsuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Watch: Iranians express mixed opinions over war recovery
english: Iranians in Tehran are showing conflicting views regarding the country's path forward following recent military strikes and rising tensions with the United States. Tehran has issued a strong warning, labeling any nations that join the U.S.-led economic campaign against them as enemies. This reaction follows President Trump's efforts to further isolate Iran through increased economic sanctions.
amharic: በቴህራን የሚገኙ ኢራናውያን በቅርቡ በደረሰው ጥቃት እና በአሜሪካ በኩል እየጨመረ በመጣው ጫና መካከል አገሪቱ መከተል ስላለባት ቀጣይ እርምጃ የተከፋፈለ አመለካከት አላቸው። ኢራን በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት ተባባሪ የሆኑ አገራትን እንደ ጠላት እንደምትቆጥራቸው አስጠንቅቃለች። ይህ የኢራን ማስጠንቀቂያ የመጣው ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቡን በማጠናከር አገሪቱን ለማግለል በሚያደርጉት ጥረት ሳቢያ ነው።
oromo: jiraattonni magaalaa Tehraan, weerara waraanaa fi dhiibbaa diinagdee Amerikaa irratti hundaa'ee biyyattiin gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfii akkamii fudhachuu akka qabdu ilaalchisee yaada garaagaraa qabu. Iran, biyyootni duula diinagdee Amerikaan ishee irratti baname keessatti hirmaatan hundi akka diinaatti akka ilaalaman akeekkachiisteetti. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaant Traamp ergaa diinagdee biyyattii xiqqeessuuf maayiiwwan jabaa irra kaa'uu isaanii booda dha.

title: Raphinha and Lopez score braces as Barcelona trounce Elche 5-0
english: Barcelona started their La Liga title defense with an impressive 5-0 victory over Elche. Raphinha and Fermin Lopez each scored two goals, while newcomer Anthony Gordon contributed with two assists. Despite resting several key players, Barcelona dominated the match and secured a confident win to signal their intent for the season.

title: Yemen, US officials meet to discuss ‘countering Houthi propaganda’
english: Yemeni and American officials recently met to discuss strategies for combating the spread of misinformation by Houthi rebels. The leaders emphasized that providing accurate information is vital to their ongoing security efforts. This discussion occurred alongside active military operations by the Yemeni government against Houthi targets following continued maritime attacks in the Red Sea.

title: Syria confirms US-mediated talks with Israel in Jordan to ease tensions
english: Syrian and Israeli officials recently held high-level discussions in Jordan facilitated by the United States to reduce regional tensions. The parties explored the creation of a U.S.-monitored security center to prevent accidental military clashes, particularly involving Turkey. Syria emphasized that it still views the Golan Heights as its territory and prioritized a return to military boundaries established prior to December 2024.
amharic: የሶሪያ እና የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በዮርዳኖስ ተገናኝተው ውጥረትን ለመቀነስ ውይይት አድርገዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች ማንኛውንም አይነት ወታደራዊ ግጭት በተለይም ከቱርክ ጋር ሊፈጠር የሚችለውን ግጭት ለመከላከል በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር ያለ የደህንነት ማዕከል ለማቋቋም መክረዋል። ሶሪያ ጎላን ኮረብታዎች የራሷ ግዛት እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ፣ ከታህሳስ 2024 በፊት ወደነበሩት ወታደራዊ ድንበሮች መመለስ ቀዳሚው አጀንዳዋ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Siriyaa fi Israa'el gita-goree turedhabbii naannichaa hir'isuuf jecha Ameerikaan giddu-galeessummaa itti taateen Yordaanos keessatti mari'ataniiru. Gareewwan kunneen waraana tasaa fi keessattuu kan Turkey waliin wal qabatu ittisuuf, iddoo nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan to'attu hundeessuuf yaalaniiru. Siriyaan daangaan Golan yeroo ammaa qabamee jiru kan ishee akka ta'ee fi gara daangaa bara 2024 ji'a Muddee dura turetti deebi'uun dhimma iddoo duraa akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Will Donald Trump’s new sanctions against Iran work?
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to implement severe economic sanctions against Iran as part of a strategy to isolate the nation. Washington is actively urging other countries to participate in this coordinated campaign to pressure the Iranian government. In response, Iran has warned that any nation that joins these US-led efforts will be viewed as an adversary.

oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traampri Itoophiyaa keessatti dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa Iiraaniirra gahuu danda'u akka qopheessan beeksisaniiru. title: Serbia requests international assistance to battle wildfires
english: Serbia has officially asked for international help to contain severe wildfires currently spreading across the Balkan region. The government is seeking support from both the European Union and Russia to manage the escalating situation. Emergency crews are working to gain control as the fires continue to pose a significant threat.

title: US envoy Tom Barrack retracts comment that Syria’s Golan is occupied
english: US Ambassador Tom Barrack has retracted his recent statement acknowledging that the Golan Heights is occupied Syrian territory. After facing criticism from pro-Israel groups, he clarified that the official US policy remains committed to recognizing Israel's sovereignty over the area. This policy was originally established by Donald Trump in 2019 and continues to be maintained by the current administration.

title: Israel is using children’s kites as pretext to strike Gaza: Hamas
english: Hamas has accused Israel of using the launch of paper kites from Gaza as an excuse to launch new military strikes. Israel recently set a three-day deadline for these activities to stop, warning of potential evacuations and air raids if they continue. In response, Hamas officials described the Israeli threats as an attack on children and urged international bodies to intervene to protect the current ceasefire.

title: Landfill collapse kills 30 in Guinea’s capital after heavy rains
english: In Conakry, Guinea, a tragic landfill collapse caused by intense rain has claimed the lives of at least 30 people. The massive pile of trash slid onto residential areas, leaving many others injured and trapped. Emergency responders are currently working through the debris to search for additional victims.

title: EU calls on Israel to halt E1 settlement plan, address settler violence
english: The European Union has demanded that Israel cancel its E1 housing project in the West Bank, noting that such expansion threatens a potential two-state solution. Additionally, the EU expressed deep concern over rising violence by settlers against Palestinians and urged the Israeli government to hold those responsible accountable. This stance reflects the international community's broad opposition to settlement activities, which are widely considered illegal under global law.

oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa mootummaan Israa'el iddoo E1 jedhamuutti ganda ijaaruuf karoorse akka dhaabdu gaafateera. Ijaarsi kun rakkoo biyyoota lamaa gidduutti furmaata argamsiisuu danda'u irratti gufuu akka ta'u ibsameera. Kana malees, gamtichi ganda ijaartootni kunniin qe'ee Falastiinotaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiran akka dhaabanii fi namoota yakka raawwatan irratti tarkaanfiin akka fudhatamu gaafateera.

title: Iranian parliamentary committee approves provision to charge ships in Hormuz
english: A committee within the Iranian parliament has approved a proposal to begin charging fees to ships transiting through the Strait of Hormuz. These payments would cover various services, including safety, fuel, and environmental protection for vessels passing through the waterway. The draft legislation must now pass a full parliamentary vote and receive final constitutional approval before it can be enacted.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ ኮሚቴ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ በሚያልፉ መርከቦች ላይ ክፍያ ለመጣል የሚያስችል ረቂቅ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ ህግ መርከቦች በሰርጡ ውስጥ ሲያልፉ ለሚሰጡ እንደ ነዳጅ፣ የደህንነት እና የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ላሉ አገልግሎቶች ክፍያ እንዲከፍሉ ያስገድዳል። ረቂቅ ህጉ በፓርላማ ሙሉ ድምጽ ተቀባይነት ካገኘ በኋላ በህገ-መንግስቱ መሰረት ተግባራዊ ከመሆኑ በፊት የመጨረሻ ማረጋገጫ ይፈልጋል።
oromo: Koreen mana maree biyyattii Iraan, markaboota qaxxaamuraa Hormuz keessa darban irratti kaffaltii murteessuuf karoorfateera. Kaffaltiin kun tajaajiloota akka boba'aa, eegumsa fayyummaa fi nageenyaa markaboota darbaniif kan oolu ta'a. Seerri kun hanga mana maree guutuun ragga'ee fi mirkaneeffannaa dhumaa argatutti hojiirra hin oolu.

title: Is Israel about to split the occupied West Bank in half?
english: Israel is advancing the 'E1' plan, a controversial initiative that involves developing land in the occupied West Bank. Critics warn that this project could physically divide the territory, effectively preventing the creation of a viable and contiguous future Palestinian state. The plan remains a major point of contention due to its potential to permanently alter the region's geopolitical landscape.
amharic: እስራኤል በምዕራብ ባንክ የምትፈጽመውን 'E1' የተሰኘ አወዛጋቢ የመሬት ልማት እቅድ ለማራመድ እየተንቀሳቀሰች ነው። ይህ እቅድ የፍልስጤም ግዛትን በሁለት በመክፈል ለወደፊት ነጻ እና የተሳሰረ የፍልስጤም ሀገር የመመስረት እድልን በእጅጉ እንደሚያደናቅፍ ተገልጿል። ይህም በክልሉ ላይ ዘላቂ የሆነ የፖለቲካ እና የጂኦግራፊያዊ ለውጥ ሊያመጣ እንደሚችል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Israa'el karoora 'E1' jedhamu kan lafa Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) irratti hojjetamu jabeessitee itti fufaa jirti. Karoorri kun lafa kana bakka lamatti hiruu danda'a kan jedhame yoo ta'u, kunis gara fuulduraatti biyya Falasxiin kan taate walitti hidhamtee ijaaramuu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'a. Hojiiwwan kunis haala siyaas-lafaa naannichaa yeroo dheeraaf jijjiiruu waan danda'uuf mormii guddaan irratti ka'aa jira.

title: Severe winds toss four aircraft across Italian airport tarmac
english: Extremely powerful winds reaching 120 km/h struck an airport in Forlì, Italy, causing significant damage. The gusts were strong enough to push and flip four light aircraft that were parked on the tarmac. As a result of these dangerous conditions, airport operations were temporarily halted for one hour.
amharic: በጣሊያን ፎርሊ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በሰዓት 120 ኪሎ ሜትር ፍጥነት ያለው ኃይለኛ ነፋስ በመነሳቱ በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው የነበሩ አራት ትናንሽ አውሮፕላኖች ተገልብጠዋል። በዚህ አስከፊ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት የአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው ለአንድ ሰዓት ያህል አገልግሎት መስጠት አቋርጦ ነበር።
oromo: Buufata xiyyaaraa biyya Xaaliyaanii kan ta'e Forlii keessatti bubbeen hamma dhibba tokko fi digdamii (120) km/h ga'u xiyyaarota xixiqqoo afur lafa irra turan fonqolcheera. Haala qilleensaa hamaa kanaan walqabatee, buufanni xiyyaaraa sun yeroof sa'aatii tokkoof tajaajila addaan kutee ture.

title: Photos: IndyCars speed past Washington landmarks as part of Freedom 250
english: The inaugural Freedom 250 IndyCar race took place in Washington, DC, featuring drivers racing past iconic sites like the US Capitol and the Washington Monument. Established by President Donald Trump to celebrate the nation's 250th anniversary, the event drew large crowds for a challenging 250-mile street circuit. Alex Palou secured the pole position for this historic race, which showcased high-speed motor racing in the heart of the American capital.
amharic: የመጀመሪያው የፍሪደም 250 ኢንዲካር ውድድር በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የተካሄደ ሲሆን ተሽከርካሪዎቹ እንደ አሜሪካ ካፒቶል እና ዋሽንግተን ሀውልት ባሉ ታዋቂ ቦታዎች አጠገብ ተሽቀዳድመዋል። የዩናይትድ ስቴትስን 250ኛ ዓመት የምስረታ በዓል ለማክበር በፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተጀመረው ይህ ውድድር፣ በከተማው ጎዳናዎች ላይ 250 ማይል ርቀት ተሸፍኗል። አሌክስ ፓሎ ለዚህ ታሪካዊ ውድድር ቀዳሚውን ስፍራ በመያዝ፣ በዋና ከተማዋ እምብርት ላይ የተከናወነውን ይህንን የፍጥነት ውድድር በበላይነት መርቷል።
oromo: Guyyaan wal-dorgommii konkolaataa Freedom 250 jedhamu magaalaa Washington DC keessatti kan jalqabame yoo ta'u, dorgomtoonni kunis bakkeewwan seena-qabeeyyii kan akka US Capitol fi yaadannoo Washington bira darbanii fiiganiiru. Ayyaana waggaa 250ffaa biyyattii kabajuuf Pireezidaant Donald Trumpin kan qophaa'e dorgommiin kun, namoota hedduu kan hawwate yoo ta'u, daandiiwwan magaalattii keessa qaxxaamuruun maayila 250 kan haguuge dha. Alex Palou dorgommii seenaa qabeessa kana irratti iddoo jalqabaa kan qabate yoo ta'u, dorgommiin kunis ganda guddoo Ameerikaa keessatti saffisaan kan raawwatame dha.
